The '''1925–26 Scottish Division One''' season was won by [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]] by eight points over nearest rival [[Airdrieonians F.C. (1878)|Airdrieonians]]. [[Raith Rovers F.C.|Raith Rovers]] and [[Clydebank F.C. (1914)|Clydebank]] finished 19th and 20th respectively and were relegated to the [[1926–27 Scottish Division Two]].
